title: Pump unreachable
body:
#Solved#

Good morning everyone,
Last night when I changed my Omnipod Dash, I started getting the message “Pump unreachable” in AAPS (version 3.3.2.1).
I replaced the pod with a new one, but the same issue happened again.
When I restart the phone, the app connects to the pump the first time, but shortly after it starts showing “Pump unreachable” again.
This morning I updated AAPS to version 3.4.1.0, but the problem still persists.
I’m using Android 16 / One UI 8.0 on a Samsung S25+, and everything was working fine until now. There have also been no system or phone updates.
Has anyone experienced something similar or knows what might be causing this? Any help much appreciated!

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f46faf6c-6c0a-4593-84ce-2d5e2cbbee08)

comments.body:
Hi,
Be sure, your "Nearby devices" are all removed, apart for AAPS:
https://androidaps.readthedocs.io/en/latest/GettingHelp/BluetoothTroubleshooting.html
Solved thanks to Chris! Alexa nearby permissions caused the problem!
